enchantments.tooltip: Deathblock: The wearer of this item is immune to all death spells and magical death effects.
Resistance +7: Passive: +7 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Negative Energy Absorption: This effect absorbs negative energy and energy drain effects.
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
